description:
Take your web app codebase and transform it into a cross platform desktop app with native functionality.


- Upgraded ToDesktop Builder and apps created with it from Electron 38 to Electron 43.
- Improved native-module compatibility and packaging support for Electron 43.
- Improved local macOS app signing, including support for native features such as notifications.
- Local Run now automatically rebuilds cached apps after relevant Builder upgrades.
- Reduced the Builder’s packaged size by removing unused platform-specific components.
- Internal bug fixes and improvements.
